title: MediaSinkWantsPayload
description: Voice op 15 MEDIA_SINK_WANTS: keys are SSRCs as decimal strings, values the wanted quality 0-100. Selects the simulcast layer. Screen-share packets are opt-in: a subscriber receives a publisher's screen (the SSRC announced with `type: screen` in VIDEO) only after listing that SSRC with quality > 0; otherwise the SFU skips the packets. Opting in also makes the streamer's op 40 STREAM_VIEWERS list include the subscriber.
